CREATE TABLE local_observations (
    path BLOB PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    observation_json TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE remote_inventory (
    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (singleton = 1),
    cursor TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE dropbox_binding (
    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (singleton = 1),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    root_namespace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    remote_root TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE "recovery_records" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    original_path BLOB NOT NULL,
    recovery_path BLOB NOT NULL,
    content_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'completed')),
    retained_at INTEGER CHECK (
        retained_at IS NULL OR (status = 'completed' AND retained_at >= 0)
    )
) STRICT
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
CREATE TABLE legacy_local_root_adoption (\n    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (singleton = 1)\n) STRICT

CREATE TABLE local_hash_cache (
    root_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (root_generation >= 1),
    path BLOB NOT NULL,
    hash_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (root_generation, path)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE "baselines" (
    path BLOB PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    baseline_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_path BLOB NOT NULL
) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX baselines_by_canonical_path\n    ON baselines(canonical_path)

CREATE TABLE "remote_observations" (
    path BLOB PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    observation_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_path BLOB NOT NULL
) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX remote_observations_by_canonical_path\n    ON remote_observations(canonical_path)
CREATE INDEX remote_directories\n    ON remote_observations(canonical_path)\n    WHERE observation_json = '"Directory"'

CREATE TABLE "conflicts" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    path BLOB NOT NULL,
    conflict_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_path BLOB NOT NULL
) STRICT
CREATE INDEX conflicts_by_canonical_path\n    ON conflicts(canonical_path)

CREATE TABLE "plans" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    path BLOB NOT NULL,
    canonical_path BLOB NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'blocked', 'completed')),
    blocked_json TEXT,
    retry_at INTEGER,
    CHECK ((status = 'blocked') = (blocked_json IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((status = 'blocked') = (retry_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (retry_at IS NULL OR retry_at >= 0)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE "operations" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "plans"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
    operation_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'completed')),
    UNIQUE (plan_id, ordinal)
) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_live_plan_per_path\n    ON plans(canonical_path) WHERE status IN ('pending', 'blocked')
CREATE INDEX plans_by_canonical_path\n    ON plans(canonical_path)
CREATE INDEX operations_by_plan\n    ON operations(plan_id, ordinal)

CREATE TABLE "local_root_binding" (
    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (singleton = 1),
    canonical_path BLOB NOT NULL,
    inode BLOB NOT NULL,
    birth_seconds INTEGER,
    birth_nanoseconds INTEGER,
    subvolume BLOB,
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 1),
    CHECK ((birth_seconds IS NULL) = (birth_nanoseconds IS NULL)),
    CHECK (birth_nanoseconds IS NULL OR birth_nanoseconds BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999),
    CHECK (birth_seconds IS NOT NULL OR subvolume IS NULL)
) STRICT
